packagePolicyId.description: The ID of the package policy

force.description: When true, delete the package policy even if it is managed

onboarding_deployment_id.description: ID of the cloud onboarding instance that manages the package policies. Required to change package policies managed by a cloud onboarding instance; only the onboarding flow is expected to set it. Requests that change a managed package policy without a matching ID are rejected with a 400 error, and `force` does not bypass this check. A bulk delete that includes such a package policy is rejected as a whole.
